title: Ikirego cy'ububasha busesuye
intro: Mu bihe bya kera, umuntu ukomeye yazamutse ajya gutegeka igihugu kinini n'abaturage bacyo. Ubutegetsi bw'uyu muntu bwaranzwe n'ishema rikomeye n'ishyano rikomeye ku butegetsi bw'Imana. Itegure kugaragaza uwo ari we wese, amaherezo ye akaba ari isomo ridashira ku bisekuru byose.
clues: Nafashe ubutegetsi ku ngoma ikomeye, aho ijambo ryanjye ryari itegeko.
Navuze ko ndi imana isumba izindi zose, nsaba abantu bose bari munsi y’ubutegetsi bwanjye gusengwa.
Nakandamije umuryango runaka, mbashyira mu bucakara kandi ntegeka ko abana babo b'abahungu bicwa.
Nahuye kenshi n'intumwa y'Imana yicisha bugufi, yakoreye ibitangaza bisobanutse imbere yanjye n'abapfumu banjye.
Nanze ukuri ntashidikanya, nshinje intumwa y’Imana ubupfumu kandi ncura umugambi wo kumwica we n’abayoboke be.
Ingabo zanjye zose hamwe n'ingabo zanjye twari twarenzwe n'inyanja ubwo twakurikiranaga abari barabohowe mu maboko yanjye tudahwema.
arabic: فَأَتْبَعَهُمْ فِرْعَوْنُ بِجُنُودِهِۦ فَغَشِيَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْيَمِّ مَا غَشِيَهُمْ
verse: So Pharaoh pursued them with his soldiers, and there covered them from the sea that which covered them, (20:78)
